entries.headline: Weekly flu toll hits reported five-year high: 44 deaths, 219 severe cases
entries.why: Multiple outlets carried the figures from 8 to 10 October, and doctors are explicitly urging enhanced (adjuvanted or high-dose) vaccines for high-risk older adults. Severity coverage drives demand in both the public programme (公費) and the self-pay market (自費), although most articles do not state funding.
entries.headline_zh: 流感單週疫情創報導中的五年新高：44人死亡、219例重症
entries.why_zh: 多家媒體於10月8日至10日報導相關數據，醫師明確呼籲高風險長者接種加強型（含佐劑或高劑量）疫苗。重症報導同時帶動公費與自費市場需求，但多數報導未說明經費來源。

entries.headline: Public programme passes 1.91 million flu shots in 8 days; COVID-19 at 655,000
entries.why: This concerns the public programme (公費). Outlets report COVID-19 vaccinations up about 50% and Kaohsiung first-week uptake more than 20% above last year, consistent with the CDC's 6 October statement that uptake is running ahead of last year.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗8天接種突破191萬劑；COVID-19疫苗達65.5萬劑
entries.why_zh: 本則涉及公費計畫。媒體報導COVID-19疫苗接種量成長約50%，高雄首週接種量較去年高出逾20%，與疾管署10月6日表示接種進度超前去年一致。

entries.headline: 150,000 Novavax COVID-19 doses arrive; outlets report use from late October
entries.why: This concerns public programme (公費) supply. The CDC's 1 October notice listed Novavax as supplied, so the reported late-October timing is a detail for stakeholders to clarify.
entries.headline_zh: 15萬劑Novavax COVID-19疫苗到貨；媒體報導10月下旬起使用
entries.why_zh: 本則涉及公費供應。疾管署10月1日公告已將Novavax列為供應品項，因此報導所稱10月下旬啟用的時程，有待利害關係人釐清。

entries.headline: Self-pay flu stock looks thin: Kaohsiung clinics say November, Lienchiang limits slots
entries.why: In the self-pay market (自費), a user reports that two Kaohsiung clinics will not have stock until November, and Lienchiang County opened self-pay bookings with limited slots. In the separate public arena (公費), posts say some clinics stock only one brand and parents are seeking specific brands.
entries.headline_zh: 自費流感疫苗庫存吃緊：高雄診所稱11月才到貨，連江縣名額有限
entries.why_zh: 自費市場方面，有網友表示高雄兩家診所要到11月才有貨，連江縣開放自費預約但名額有限。另在公費方面，貼文指出部分診所僅供應單一廠牌，家長正在尋找特定廠牌。

entries.headline: Clinic post makes unverified efficacy and 12-month claims for adjuvanted flu vaccine
entries.why: A clinic-level promotional post with notable engagement makes comparative efficacy claims for a prescription vaccine, which creates advertising-compliance and reputational exposure for adjuvanted flu brands. Funding is not stated, but this appears to be clinic-driven demand generation.
entries.headline_zh: 診所貼文宣稱含佐劑流感疫苗效力較佳且保護12個月，未經證實
entries.why_zh: 一則互動量可觀的診所層級宣傳貼文，對處方疫苗做出比較性效力宣稱，為含佐劑流感疫苗品牌帶來廣告法規遵循與聲譽風險。貼文未說明經費來源，但看似由診所主導的需求開發。

entries.headline: Side-effect posts draw high engagement; first vaccine injury relief award reported
entries.why: Users post day-by-day post-shot symptom logs and parents ask about fever after nasal spray vaccine. Public TV reports an NT$50,000 relief award for leg paralysis, a public-programme trust issue that needs issue-readiness.
entries.headline_zh: 副作用貼文互動熱烈；首件預防接種受害救濟給付見報
entries.why_zh: 網友逐日記錄接種後症狀，家長詢問接種鼻噴疫苗後發燒問題。公視報導一件腿部癱瘓獲救濟NT$50,000的案例，屬公費計畫的信任議題，需做好議題應對準備。

watch.text: Reported start of Novavax COVID-19 vaccine use from the 150,000 doses that have arrived.
watch.text_zh: 報導指出已到貨的15萬劑Novavax COVID-19疫苗將開始使用。

watch.text: Second stage of publicly funded flu vaccination opens; watch eligibility expansion and stock pressure.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打；留意接種對象擴大與庫存壓力。

watch.text: Self-pay flu stock reportedly due at Kaohsiung clinics; doctors say flu activity may not cool until November.
watch.text_zh: 據報高雄診所自費流感疫苗屆時到貨；醫師表示流感疫情可能到11月才會趨緩。

qa.q: Is flu severity still escalating, and how is it framed?
qa.a: Several outlets report a five-year weekly high of 44 deaths and 219 severe cases, and Kaohsiung reports 150 cumulative severe cases and 35 deaths. Doctors frame this around older and chronically ill people, and some call for enhanced vaccines.
qa.q_zh: 流感重症是否持續升溫？報導如何定調？
qa.a_zh: 多家媒體報導單週44人死亡、219例重症，創五年新高；高雄累計150例重症、35人死亡。醫師聚焦於長者及慢性病患，部分醫師呼籲接種加強型疫苗。

qa.q: Is there anything new on enhanced flu vaccines in the public programme?
qa.a: There is no new official update since the 1 October launch notice prioritising enhanced vaccines for long-term care residents aged 65 and over. Enhanced-vaccine mentions fell to 27 from 83 week on week. This week's coverage is doctors' advocacy plus a clinic post making unverified efficacy claims.
qa.q_zh: 公費計畫中的加強型流感疫苗有無新進展？
qa.a_zh: 自10月1日開打公告優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民加強型疫苗後，官方無新的更新。加強型疫苗提及量較前週由83則降至27則。本週報導為醫師倡議，以及一則宣稱效力未經證實的診所貼文。

qa.q: Is there any RSV or Tdap signal worth tracking?
qa.a: RSV mentions rose to 16 from 3, driven by a report of 16 infants in a cluster infection at a Changhua postpartum care home (the pathogen is not specified in coverage) and a post summarising a European maternal RSV study. Tdap has 6 mentions, linked to medical societies urging vaccines for chronic lung disease patients. There are no official notices on either.
qa.q_zh: RSV或Tdap是否有值得追蹤的訊號？
qa.a_zh: RSV提及量由3則升至16則，主因是彰化一家產後護理之家16名嬰兒群聚感染的報導（報導未指明病原體），以及一則整理歐洲孕婦RSV研究的貼文。Tdap有6則提及，與醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗有關。兩者皆無官方公告。

policy_notes.why: This pre-launch notice set the 11 eligible groups, supply, self-pay options and the 1,350 health-coin incentive, framing both the public and self-pay arenas for the season.
policy_notes.why_zh: 此開打前公告訂定11類接種對象、供應量、自費選項及1,350健康幣獎勵，為本季公費與自費市場定調。

policy_notes.why: The official launch confirmed enhanced flu vaccines are prioritised for long-term care residents aged 65 and over and that both Moderna and Novavax COVID-19 vaccines are supplied.
policy_notes.why_zh: 官方正式開打時確認加強型流感疫苗優先提供65歲以上長照機構住民，且Moderna與Novavax兩款COVID-19疫苗皆有供應。

policy_notes.why: The CDC reported uptake above last year and urged high-risk groups to vaccinate before holiday travel, signalling strong early demand on public programme stock.
policy_notes.why_zh: 疾管署表示接種量高於去年，並呼籲高風險族群於連假出遊前接種，顯示公費庫存早期需求強勁。

misinfo.claim: Adjuvanted flu vaccine gives 20-30% better protection than standard vaccines and lasts a full 12 months
misinfo.note: Route to medical and regulatory teams to review clinic-level promotion against Taiwan's prescription-medicine advertising rules; do not amplify, and prepare evidence-based stakeholder briefing lines.
misinfo.claim_zh: 含佐劑流感疫苗保護力比一般疫苗高20-30%，且可維持整整12個月
misinfo.note_zh: 轉交醫學與法規團隊，依台灣處方藥廣告規範審視診所層級宣傳；勿擴散，並準備有實證依據的利害關係人說明口徑。

misinfo.claim: Vaccines contain viruses, so calls for seniors to get vaccinated endanger them
misinfo.note: Low engagement; monitor for spread into local community channels serving older adults.
misinfo.claim_zh: 疫苗含有病毒，呼籲長者接種反而危害他們
misinfo.note_zh: 互動量低；監測是否擴散至服務長者的地方社群管道。

misinfo.claim: Giving flu and COVID-19 shots together causes an 'immune storm' and officials exploit the outbreak for elections
misinfo.note: Single comment with political framing; track whether co-administration safety questions grow as the joint campaign continues.
misinfo.claim_zh: 流感與COVID-19疫苗同時接種會引發「免疫風暴」，官員藉疫情操作選舉
misinfo.note_zh: 單一帶有政治框架的留言；隨合併接種持續進行，追蹤同時接種安全性疑問是否增加。

misinfo.claim: US autopsies show a 74% COVID-19 vaccine fatality rate
misinfo.note: Taiwan FactCheck Center has already rated this misleading; reference the fact-check if the claim resurfaces.
misinfo.claim_zh: 美國解剖顯示COVID-19疫苗致死率達74%
misinfo.note_zh: 台灣事實查核中心已判定為誤導；若此說法再度出現，可引用該查核報告。

narratives.title_zh: 嬰兒RSV：護理之家群聚與孕婦接種
narratives.para_zh: 本週RSV提及量由3則升至16則，主因是彰化產後護理之家16名嬰兒群聚感染報導，以及整理歐洲產前RSV疫苗接種數據的貼文。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV volume rose from 3 to 16 items. News reports a cluster infection among 16 infants at a Changhua postpartum care home within 20 days; the coverage is tagged to RSV, but the pathogen detail should be confirmed. A social post summarises European real-world data on prenatal RSV vaccination. Nothing mentions nirsevimab or infant antibodies by name.
products.implication: A postpartum-centre cluster can quickly raise questions from parents, care-home operators and local health bureaus about infant RSV prevention options. Conversation is currently framed around maternal vaccination rather than infant antibodies.
products.action: Confirm the facts of the Changhua cluster through official channels before any engagement. Prepare a neutral evidence pack on infant RSV burden and prevention approaches for neonatology and paediatric experts and health authorities. Map postpartum-care regulators and operators so the team is ready if the issue escalates.
who: Postpartum care centre operators and their regulators
products.signal_zh: RSV聲量由3則升至16則。新聞報導彰化一家產後護理之家20天內16名嬰兒群聚感染；報導被歸類為RSV，但病原體細節仍待確認。一則社群貼文整理歐洲產前RSV疫苗接種的真實世界數據。沒有任何內容具名提及nirsevimab或嬰兒抗體。
products.implication_zh: 產後護理之家群聚事件可能迅速引發家長、業者及地方衛生局對嬰兒RSV預防選項的疑問。目前討論以孕婦接種為主，而非嬰兒抗體。
products.action_zh: 任何互動前，先透過官方管道確認彰化群聚事件事實。為新生兒科與小兒科專家及衛生主管機關準備中立的嬰兒RSV疾病負擔與預防方式實證資料。盤點產後護理之家主管機關與業者，以便議題升溫時團隊已做好準備。
who_zh: 新生兒科與小兒科醫學會
產後護理之家業者及其主管機關

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), licensed 65+, enhanced vaccine in the public programme
products.signal: Coverage of the five-year-high flu toll has doctors urging enhanced vaccines, described as adjuvanted and high-dose, for older high-risk people and chronic patients. A health video on people aged 50+ with comorbidities mentions high-dose vaccines. High-dose volume eased from 19 to 12 items and enhanced from 83 to 27 as launch coverage faded. A separate clinic post making comparative claims about an adjuvanted vaccine is flagged as misleading.
products.implication: The severity story keeps clinicians talking about enhanced vaccines for older adults, which may raise demand and access questions beyond the long-term-care residents prioritised for the 200,790 public doses. Comparative claims in clinic promotion create category-level regulatory and reputational exposure.
products.action: Prepare factual briefing material on licensed age, public allocation and long-term-care rollout for health bureaus and facility operators. Ready a reactive line on access questions from older adults outside the priority group. Audit company and partner materials so nothing resembles comparative or consumer-facing claims under TFDA advertising rules.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），核准用於65歲以上，公費計畫中的加強型疫苗
products.signal_zh: 流感疫情創五年新高的報導中，醫師呼籲高風險長者與慢性病患接種加強型疫苗（即含佐劑與高劑量疫苗）。一支針對50歲以上共病族群的衛教影片提及高劑量疫苗。隨開打報導退燒，高劑量聲量由19則降至12則，加強型由83則降至27則。另有一則對含佐劑疫苗做比較性宣稱的診所貼文被標示為誤導。
products.implication_zh: 重症議題使臨床醫師持續討論長者接種加強型疫苗，可能在優先接種200,790劑公費疫苗的長照機構住民之外，引發需求與取得問題。診所宣傳中的比較性宣稱，為整個品類帶來法規與聲譽風險。
products.action_zh: 為衛生局與機構業者準備核准年齡、公費配置及長照機構接種推動的事實說明資料。針對優先族群以外長者的取得問題，備妥回應口徑。依食藥署廣告規範稽核公司及合作夥伴素材，確保無類似比較性或面向消費者的宣稱。
who_zh: 老年醫學會與感染症醫學會

products.name: Tdap booster
products.sub: pertussis booster for adults and pregnancy
products.signal: Little signal this week. Tdap appears in six items, up from none, all within storylines about medical societies urging vaccinations for chronic lung disease patients alongside RSV. No individual Tdap item ranks among the top news or posts.
products.implication: Tdap is entering the chronic-lung-disease conversation through medical societies rather than through pertussis outbreaks or pregnancy, but the volume is too thin to draw conclusions.
products.action: Monitor the medical-society messaging on chronic lung disease. Keep adult and maternal pertussis evidence summaries up to date for expert dialogue, without launching proactive outreach on this little signal.
products.sub_zh: 成人及孕婦百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 本週訊號微弱。Tdap出現在6則內容中（前週為0），皆屬醫學會呼籲慢性肺病患者接種疫苗（連同RSV）的報導脈絡。沒有任何單則Tdap內容進入熱門新聞或貼文排行。
products.implication_zh: Tdap是透過醫學會進入慢性肺病討論，而非因百日咳疫情或孕期議題，但聲量太少，無法下定論。
products.action_zh: 監測醫學會關於慢性肺病的訊息。持續更新成人與孕婦百日咳實證摘要以供專家對話，但不因此微弱訊號主動展開溝通。
who_zh: 胸腔暨重症醫學相關學會

products.name: Novavax (Nuvaxovid) XFG COVID-19 vaccine
products.sub: protein-based, distributed in Taiwan by Sanofi, public programme
products.signal: Two outlets report that 150,000 Novavax doses have arrived in Taiwan, with use planned from late October. Taiwan CDC's 1 October launch notice lists Novavax as a supplied COVID-19 vaccine. Other reports on joint-campaign uptake and a respiratory-season vaccine guide also mention Novavax.
products.implication: Because the programme opened on 1 October but Novavax use is reported for late October, people who want this vaccine and the clinics serving them may face timing and availability questions. How the start is communicated will shape early perceptions of supply.
products.action: Align with Taiwan CDC on the confirmed start date and the public wording. Prepare a stock, distribution and timing Q&A for local health bureaus and contracted clinics. Set up monitoring for access complaints once the late-October start arrives.
products.sub_zh: 蛋白質疫苗，由Sanofi在台經銷，公費計畫
products.signal_zh: 兩家媒體報導15萬劑Novavax疫苗已抵台，預計10月下旬起使用。疾管署10月1日開打公告將Novavax列為供應中的COVID-19疫苗。其他關於合併接種進度及呼吸道季節疫苗指南的報導也提及Novavax。
products.implication_zh: 由於計畫於10月1日開打，但Novavax據報10月下旬才使用，想接種此疫苗的民眾及服務他們的診所可能面臨時程與供應問題。啟用時間的溝通方式將影響外界對供應的初步觀感。
products.action_zh: 與疾管署對齊確認的啟用日期與對外用語。為地方衛生局與合約院所準備庫存、配送與時程Q&A。10月下旬啟用後，建立取得相關抱怨的監測機制。

issues.title: Novavax COVID-19 vaccine start date and clinic availability
issues.note: Reports place the Novavax start in late October, after the 1 October programme opening; expect media and clinic questions on timing, site lists and dose allocation for the 150,000 doses.
issues.title_zh: Novavax COVID-19疫苗啟用日期與診所供應
issues.note_zh: 報導指Novavax於10月下旬啟用，晚於10月1日計畫開打；預期媒體與診所將詢問15萬劑的時程、接種地點名單及劑量配置。

issues.title: Second-stage public flu rollout coinciding with self-pay stock arrival
issues.note: Second-stage eligibility opens as posts say some clinics will only stock self-pay flu vaccine in November; with severity at a five-year high, access and brand-availability complaints may grow.
issues.title_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打，恰逢自費疫苗到貨
issues.note_zh: 第二階段接種對象開放之際，貼文指部分診所11月才會有自費流感疫苗；加上重症創五年新高，取得與廠牌供應相關抱怨可能增加。

issues.title: Comparative enhanced-vaccine claims in clinic promotion
issues.note: A clinic post making comparative protection claims for an adjuvanted vaccine is flagged as misleading; similar claims could draw regulator or media scrutiny of the whole enhanced category.
issues.title_zh: 診所宣傳中的加強型疫苗比較性宣稱
issues.note_zh: 一則對含佐劑疫苗做比較性保護力宣稱的診所貼文被標示為誤導；類似宣稱可能引來主管機關或媒體檢視整個加強型品類。

self_pay.title: Self-pay flu stock delayed in places
self_pay.note: A Kaohsiung user reports two clinics said self-pay flu vaccine will not arrive until November, and Lienchiang County opened self-pay bookings with limited slots. Both point to constrained early self-pay supply while public demand peaks.
self_pay.title_zh: 部分地區自費流感疫苗延遲到貨
self_pay.note_zh: 一名高雄網友表示兩家診所稱自費流感疫苗要到11月才到貨，連江縣開放自費預約但名額有限。兩者皆顯示公費需求高峰期間，早期自費供應受限。

self_pay.title: Clinic promotion of adjuvanted flu vaccine
self_pay.note: A clinic post invites people to get an adjuvanted flu vaccine and cites comparative protection and duration figures; it is flagged as misleading. The post does not say whether the shot is public or self-pay, but it shows clinic-level promotion of enhanced vaccines is active.
self_pay.title_zh: 診所宣傳含佐劑流感疫苗
self_pay.note_zh: 一則診所貼文邀請民眾接種含佐劑流感疫苗，並引用比較性的保護力與持續時間數據，被標示為誤導。貼文未說明屬公費或自費，但顯示診所層級的加強型疫苗宣傳正活躍。

self_pay.title: Holiday sites mention self-paid shots
self_pay.note: Coverage of holiday combined flu and COVID-19 vaccination sites mentions self-paid vaccination, but gives no prices or brand detail.
self_pay.title_zh: 假日接種站提及自費接種
self_pay.note_zh: 假日流感與COVID-19疫苗合併接種站的報導提及自費接種，但未提供價格或廠牌資訊。

self_pay.title: No self-pay signal for high-dose flu, RSV antibodies or Tdap
self_pay.note: This week's items say nothing about self-pay prices, clinic stock or private demand for high-dose flu vaccine, infant RSV antibodies or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 高劑量流感疫苗、RSV抗體及Tdap無自費訊號
self_pay.note_zh: 本週內容未提及高劑量流感疫苗、嬰兒RSV抗體或Tdap的自費價格、診所庫存或私人需求。
